title: DNV Sesam — Fixed offshore wind structure design (jacket, topside, transport and lift figures)
description: 3D model views and analysis diagrams for jacket legs/joints, shell transition pieces, hotspot fatigue, seismic effects, concrete gravity-base structures, corrosion potentials, transportation sea-fastening, topside lifting and substation/OSS arrangement. | Figures: Figure 3.1 — The leg is modelled as a beam concept; Figure 3.2 — A joint modelled with shell elements within a beam model; Figure 3.3 — Shell transition piece connected to the jacket and tower; Figure 3.7 — A jacket including wave and soil environment in GeniE; Figure 4.4 — Hotspots around a tubular cross-section are used in the fatigue analysis; Figure 4.6 — Seismic time histories can be included as prescribed accelerations
